title: Text wrapper leaves no trailing space when a long word follows an exactly-full line
source: CPython commit 1c598e04361dbfc9cf465f3a02f83715c11b028c (gh-139065, GH-139070) dated 2025-10-10, fixing Lib/textwrap.py
false_flag_note: A reviewer might read the added space_left > 0 condition as changing long-word breaking: previously an empty slice of the word was appended to the current line in this situation, which looks harmless. That empty chunk was the bug -- it became the line's last chunk, so the drop-whitespace cleanup removed it instead of the separating space chunk, and the emitted line kept a trailing space. When space_left is 0 nothing of the word could be placed anyway, so no breaking behaviour is lost.
